title: Coordinated Launch Compass and Chokepoint Mitigation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Multiple product teams (runtime, console, API) have independent release cadences that cause last-minute capacity contention, rollout window conflicts across regions, and unclear ownership for rollback and mitigation when token-level latency or cost regressions appear.

Goal: Create a compact, repeatable 'Launch Compass' playbook that sequences cross-team release trains during a two-week cadence, aligns capacity reservations, defines choke-point detection and early mitigation policies, and ties launches to OKR milestones and runbook ownership. This ticket owns scoping, stakeholder alignment, and the initial pilot for March launches.

Scope: The playbook covers: 1) a standardized release sequencing template (preflight -> canary -> ramp -> full), 2) capacity reservation guidelines for Dedicated and Hosted tiers, 3) API/Console/Runtime alignment checklist and cutover signals, 4) monitoring & rollback gates (SLOs, token-cost, error-rate thresholds), 5) communication and escalation matrix, 6) integration points with Console rollout UI and Alerts dashboards. Excluded: CI-level test flakiness fixes and platform-level kernel changes (handled by ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria: A single-page Launch Compass document exists and is approved by PM/Eng/Design leads
Pilot run for March launches executed with assigned owners and no unplanned rollback due to capacity contention
Capacity reservation playbook includes concrete quota templates for Dedicated pools and fallback routing rules for Hosted tier
Monitoring dashboard widgets and alerting thresholds are defined and wired to on-call escalation paths
Post-launch retro template and OKR alignment section added so launches are tied to measurable initiative outcomes

Capacity reservation templates (Liam + Eng infra lead: Priya Rao) — provide Dedicated quota numbers and fallback rules
Canary and rollback gates (Eng SRE: Mateo Alvarez) — define SLO thresholds, smoke test suite for canary signal
Console rollout integration (Design: Noor Malik + Console Eng: Rina Gupta) — add UI flow for cutover and rollback with owner attribution

Stakeholder review (Cross-team review meeting) — schedule and capture approvals
Pilot execution (owners above) — run through one end-to-end launch in the March cohort
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Capacity numbers are estimated and may underprovision during stress — Mitigation: reserve 20% buffer and enable automated fallback to cheaper model variants
Risk: Late-breaking API contract changes from product teams — Mitigation: enforce freeze window in the 48 hours before canary and require schema compatibility sign-off
Risk: Observability gaps for token-level cost — Mitigation: instrument sampling for medium/large requests and add synthetic traffic generator for preflight

SLO owners: Runtime SRE for latency, API team for error-rate, CostOps for token-cost regressions
